evidence.passage: We additionally report a hybrid configuration that interpolates BM25 and dense scores with α = 0.3 as a reference point.
evidence.quote: interpolates BM25 and dense scores with α = 0.3

evidence.passage: The hybrid configuration from Section 2.2 does not improve over our tuned dense retriever on HotpotQA, suggesting lexical signals matter less for multi-hop questions. Overall, on HotpotQA our tuned dense retriever is within 0.5 points of the hybrid configuration across all retrieval budgets.
evidence.quote: The hybrid configuration from Section 2.2 does not improve over our tuned dense retriever on HotpotQA
